blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Department of Transportation (DOTr) on Wednesday, formally installed its new heads of three attached agencies, with Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon outlining their priorities as part of the department’s push for faster reforms. Dizon introduced the new chiefs of the Land Transportation Office (LTO), Maritime Industry Authority (Marina), and Philippine National Railways (PNR)
